Title: Pride and Prejudice
Research Assistant Team: Emma Ainsworth, Leia Soulsbury, and Rowan Watts
Notes: Since Austen does not name any year explicitly in Pride and Prejudice  scholars disagree on when it takes place. Some assume the main action takes place in 1811-1812 around the time Austen wrote the novel. Others  such as Deirdre Le Faye believe it takes place in 1793-1794 because of the militia’s presence in the region and because of the correspondence of the dates. We chose to use 1790’s  but the order of the events remains the same  so someone who prefers the later calendar would get the same graph just 8 years higher. We referenced Andrews  P. B. S. “The Date of ‘Pride and Prejudice.’” Notes and Queries  vol. 15  no. 9  1968  pp. 338–42; Le Faye  Deirdre. “Pride and Prejudice: Chapman’s Internal Dating Corrected.” Notes and Queries  vol. 65  no. 3  2018  pp. 351–57; and  R.W. Chapman “Chronology of Pride and Prejudice.” The Novels of Jane Austen  3rd ed.  vol.2  Oxford UP  1933.

Title: The Fifth Season
Notes: The Fifth Season does not mention any specific dates, although the chronology unfolds over the span of a few decades. The novel's storyworld may or may not be a future version of our earth. We chose dates set in the future in an effort to capture the passage of time and to allow for the possibility that the stillness is our future. The dates should not be read literally.

Title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
Research Assistant Team: Kyra Hetherington (with a little help from Abby Phillips and Avery McAllister through Uvic's HUMA 180 Internship)
Notes: All dates have been based on the 1990/91 calendar due to textual evidence suggesting that Harry Potter’s birthday takes place on Tuesday  July 31. Most fan communities and textual evidence from later books points to events taking place in 1990/92.
